name: Momiyama Toyomi
source:
Teacher / School Physician

Queen of the nurse's office. A teacher who continues breastcare even now. Loves drinking.

She experiments with pushing the boundaries of breastcare. (Experimenting on others is unacceptable, but using herself as the test subject is fine.) Lately she's worried that she has hit her growth limit, because the growth of her breasts seems to be slowing down.

The progatonist's father was the last person to significantly contribute to her breast growth, so she has high expectations for the protagonist.

[Translated from the [url=https://edoire.jp/products/ikunew/chr/10.html]official website[/url]]

Bust Size: 128cm S-cup -> 129cm S-cup
